regions.merged_text: Typewritten copy of Poem, Daddy and Mother Machree, To the air: "Believe Me, If All Those Endearing", by Mamie Casey McCloskey. Handwritten by Fr. Solanus on back: Written by above M.C. McC. - Youngest of sixteen children - Mother of four Religious on occasion of our dear Parents' Jubilee when there were more than forty in the Fam. - - Parents, Children and Grand Children.
